title: Organizational Structure
content:
Mine Organizational Structure:

Board of Directors
  - Chairman
  - 4 Independent Non-Executive Directors
  - 1 Executive Director (CEO)

Executive Committee
  - CEO / General Manager (Overall mine responsibility)
  - Chief Financial Officer (Finance, procurement, IT)
  - Chief Operating Officer (Mining, processing, maintenance)
  - Chief Safety Officer (Safety, health, environment)
  - Chief Geologist (Exploration, resource estimation, grade control)

Departments and Key Roles:

1. Exploration Department
   - Chief Geologist (HOD)
   - Senior Geologists (2)
   - Mine Geologists (4)
   - Geological Technician (6)
   - Drill and Blast Engineers (2)

2. Mining Department
   - Mining Manager (HOD)
   - Shift Bosses (6, two per shift)
   - Underground Supervisors (8)
   - Miners/Operators (120)
   - Truck Drivers (40)
   - Blasting Crew (12)

3. Processing Department
   - Plant Manager (HOD)
   - Metallurgical Engineers (2)
   - Process Operators (30)
   - Laboratory Technicians (6)
   - Maintenance Fitters (10)

4. Maintenance Department
   - Maintenance Manager (HOD)
   - Mechanical Engineers (3)
   - Electrical Engineers (2)
   - Instrumentation Technicians (4)
   - Fitters and Boilermakers (20)
   - Electricians (12)

5. Safety Department
   - Safety Manager (HOD)
   - Safety Officers (4)
   - First Aid Personnel (8)
   - Environmental Scientists (2)

6. Finance Department
   - Financial Manager (HOD)
   - Accountants (4)
   - Procurement Officers (3)
   - HR Officers (4)
   - IT Support (3)

Total workforce: ~1,240 (including contractors)
BEE Level: Level 2
Community Investment: 1% of net profit after tax
